title: A greeting for the wife’s sake
literal_meaning: For the wife’s sake, a respectful salutation to the younger brother-in-law.
meaning_odia: ଭାରିଜାଙ୍କ ଲାଗି ତାଙ୍କ ସାନ ଭାଇକୁ ନମସ୍କାର କରାଯାଉଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ, ଜଣଙ୍କ ସହ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ରଖିବାକୁ ତାଙ୍କ ନିକଟଜନଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତି ମଧ୍ୟ ଆଦର ଦେଖାଇବାର କଥା ଏଥିରେ ଆସେ। ଏହା ଥଟ୍ଟାର ସ୍ୱରରେ କୁହାଯାଇପାରେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ସାନ ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ସମ୍ମାନ ଦେବା ଅନୁଚିତ ବୋଲି ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The wife is the reason named for the salutation, while her younger brother receives it. Our editorial reading notices how regard for one person can extend to someone connected with them. The line can tease that indirect motive without establishing fear, compulsion or an improper act.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone makes a special effort to greet a partner’s relative warmly. A friend recalls this line with a teasing smile about courtesy extended through another relationship.
cultural_context: The saying separates the person for whose sake respect is shown from the person who receives it. ସାନ gives the recipient a younger or junior position, but the line supplies no detailed greeting ritual or rule about who may deserve respect.

witnesses.locator: Page31, final item beginning ଭାରିଜା ଲାଗି.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026; exact ଭାରିଜା and ଶଳା preserved. Brother-in-law means wife’s brother here. Interpretation of courtesy through a relationship editorial; no specific gesture or mandatory custom inferred.
